status.config:
DATALOADER:
  NUM_INSTANCE: 8
  NUM_WORKERS: 4
  SAMPLER: softmax_triplet
DATASETS:
  NAMES: RGBNT201
  ROOT_DIR: /data/gaob/Re-ID/dataset
INPUT:
  PADDING: 10
  PIXEL_MEAN:
  - 0.5
  - 0.5
  - 0.5
  PIXEL_STD:
  - 0.5
  - 0.5
  - 0.5
  PROB: 0.5
  RE_PROB: 0.5
  SIZE_TEST:
  - 256
  - 128
  SIZE_TRAIN:
  - 256
  - 128
MODEL:
  ADAPTER: false
  ATM: true
  ATT_DROP_RATE: 0.0
  DEVICE: cuda
  DEVICE_ID: '0'
  DIRECT: 1
  DIST_TRAIN: false
  DROP_OUT: 0.0
  DROP_PATH: 0.1
  FROZEN: false
  GLOBAL_LOCAL: true
  HDM: true
  HEAD: 4
  ID_LOSS_TYPE: softmax
  ID_LOSS_WEIGHT: 0.25
  IF_LABELSMOOTH: 'on'
  IF_WITH_CENTER: 'no'
  METRIC_LOSS_TYPE: triplet
  NAME: DeMo
  NECK: bnneck
  NO_MARGIN: true
  PRETRAIN_PATH_T: /data/gaob/Re-ID/Trifusion/pertrained-model/ViT-B-16.pt
  PROMPT: false
  SIE_CAMERA: true
  SIE_COE: 1.0
  SIE_VIEW: false
  STRIDE_SIZE:
  - 16
  - 16
  TRANSFORMER_TYPE: ViT-B-16
  TRIPLET_LOSS_WEIGHT: 1.0
OUTPUT_DIR: ..
SOLVER:
  BASE_LR: 0.00035
  BIAS_LR_FACTOR: 2
  CENTER_LOSS_WEIGHT: 0.0005
  CENTER_LR: 0.5
  CHECKPOINT_PERIOD: 10
  CLUSTER_MARGIN: 0.3
  COSINE_MARGIN: 0.5
  COSINE_SCALE: 30
  EVAL_PERIOD: 1
  GAMMA: 0.1
  IMS_PER_BATCH: 64
  LARGE_FC_LR: false
  LOG_PERIOD: 10
  MARGIN: 0.3
  MAX_EPOCHS: 50
  MOMENTUM: 0.9
  OPTIMIZER_NAME: Adam
  RANGE_ALPHA: 0
  RANGE_BETA: 1
  RANGE_K: 2
  RANGE_LOSS_WEIGHT: 1
  RANGE_MARGIN: 0.3
  SEED: 42
  STEPS:
  - 40
  - 70
  WARMUP_FACTOR: 0.01
  WARMUP_ITERS: 10
  WARMUP_METHOD: linear
  WEIGHT_DECAY: 0.0001
  WEIGHT_DECAY_BIAS: 0.0001
TEST:
  FEAT_NORM: 'yes'
  IMS_PER_BATCH: 128
  MISS: nothing
  NECK_FEAT: before
  RE_RANKING: 'no'
  WEIGHT: ''
status.pretraining: Full-official original RGBNT201 DeMo50 bestE28 plus additional50/new Adam; original identity encoder fixed

anchor.metric: Original globals1536 + seven identity relation slots3584; normalized after M/F/I corrections; no public25 block
anchor.common_setup_changes: Original E28 frozen identity plus matched relation-coordinate M/F/I outlet and5120 fused head. This whole setup is not a one-factor continuation of R201B/probe. Only PM/PF bypass is isolated within this fixture.
anchor.common_context: Existing shared projection/head remains trainable auxiliary/context; it is not an appended retrieval block
anchor.optimizer_schedule: Original50 plus additional50 with fresh Adam/scheduler/AMP512; no optimizer resume
anchor.control_limit: Ordinary-frequency slots mix source inputs and do not have structured physical-source provenance. Both controls use identical eligible masks, parameters, losses, output dimensions and outlet placement. Unchanged coupled contribution predictor is a task gate, not claimed calibrated.

status.checkpoint_rule: Maximum full official query/gallery mAP across 50 epochs; ties keep earliest epoch
status.evaluation_scope: Entire official training split and entire official query/gallery; no fit/dev holdout
status.selection_limitation: Official benchmark is used for checkpoint selection; this is not an untouched independent final test
status.method_revision: R201C common fixture: original RGBNT201 E28 private encoder fixed/eval, M/F/I increments share the original seven identity relation slots, no forcedpublic25 retrieval block, 5120D output equal to original DeMo. Ordinary-frequency and dual-axis use the same outlet, eligible sources, original FFT/full-partial losses/seed42/B64/P8K8/extra50 budget. Only PM/PF P(x) versus x+P(x) varies within this fixture; introduction of this whole interface versus R201B/probe is a coupled setup change. Public head remains auxiliary/context. No additional loss or new calibrated-gate claim. Full3951/836/836, no holdout, benchmark-selected best mAP with earliest ties, that fixed best for all49.
status.partial_training: Matched available-source DeMo; one uniformly sampled proper modality set per batch; stopped full-view gallery, same shared identity interface and original partial CE/triplet weights
status.amp_policy: Native fp16 GradScaler512; actual optimizer updates and skipped steps recorded
status.retention: Only best.pth; smoke strict reload in memory; no initial, last, or smoke weight files
